quests.title: The Imp on the Loose
quests.summary: The Lincoln Imp has hopped off his pillar in the Angel Choir. Follow his trail round Lincoln.

steps.text: Ask at the Strugglers Inn by the castle.
Follow the sausage trail to the Sausage Makers on Steep Hill.
Catch the Imp on the wall of Minster Yard.
Tell the Verger in the cathedral.

quests.reward: The Lincoln Imp, a Lincoln Imp Pin, plum bread and standing in England.

quests.title: Wilberforce's Petition
quests.summary: Gather three names for a petition against the slave trade, as Hull and Yorkshire did in Wilberforce's day.

steps.text: Ask for a signature on Hessle Road.
Find the churchwarden at Rudston, on the Wolds.
Win over the Parliamentary Clerk in Hull Minster.
Take the petition back to Wilberforce House.

quests.reward: A Four-Leaf Clover, Hull patties and standing in England.

quests.title: Deckie for a Day
quests.summary: Sign on with the Skipper of the Arctic Corsair for a trip down the Humber.

steps.text: Get a gansey from the knitter on Hessle Road.
Pick up a patty for the voyage at Patty and Chips.
Sail with the Skipper and pass the First Mate's test.

quests.reward: A Borelet, a Fisherman's Gansey and standing in England.

quests.title: The Great Charter
quests.summary: Hear four clauses of Lincoln's 1215 Magna Carta in the castle vault, then pass the guide's test.

steps.text: Answer the Castle Guide's three questions.

quests.reward: Lincolnshire sausages, plum bread and standing in England.
